citations.B1: Race on read-modify-write of `counts[user_id]` across threads/processes
citations.B3: fix with an atomic increment (lock, or `INCR` in Redis)
citations.B4: No time window — once `limit` is hit, user is blocked forever
citations.B5: Unbounded growth of `counts` — every distinct `user_id` stays forever, memory leak
citations.B6: Multi-worker processes each hold separate `counts` dicts — limit is per-process, not global
citations.B7: No input validation on `user_id` — `None`, unhashable, or hostile values crash
